edges.note: From a process that schedules its own next tick to an unfinished question that carries the basis for its next useful continuation.
A missing run remains a visible absence; its answer is not fabricated by neighboring runs.
The repair acts before there is proof of its result; the result is checked afterward.
The world supplies an observation that neither of the attractive explanations predicted.

claim_boundary: Literary continuation. All new scenes and dialogue are invented. Edges describe relations between stories, not empirical evidence of consciousness, autonomous self-maintenance, or independent model errors.
integration: Additive sidecar linked from the studio README; existing graph versions and nodes are not replaced.
